description_en: Queries the list of databases authorized for a user
description_zh: 查询用户已授权的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-databases-for-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-tl32swayw7o --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabasesForUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user whose authorized databases you want to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to obtain the user ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询已授权数据库的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query.  
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If this paging parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Specify a value for this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的数据库实例名称
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en: The address of the database to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的数据库地址。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: database_address

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database to query. Valid values:

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network domain for which you want to query the authorized databases
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询已授权数据库列表的网络域ID
parameters.name: network_domain_id

ActiveAddressType.description_en:
The address type of the database. Valid values:
Public: public endpoint
Private: private endpoint in the private network
ActiveAddressType.description_zh:
数据库地址类型。取值：
Public ：公网地址
Private ：私网地址

Comment.description_en: The description of the database instance
Comment.description_zh: 数据库实例的备注信息

DatabaseId.description_en: The instance ID of the database

DatabaseName.description_en: The name of the database instance

DatabasePrivateAddress.description_en: The private endpoint of the database in the private network, which can be a domain name or an IP address
DatabasePrivateAddress.description_zh: 数据库的私网地址，可为域名或IP地址

DatabasePublicAddress.description_en: The public address of the database, which can be a domain name or an IP address
DatabasePublicAddress.description_zh: 数据库的公网地址，可为域名或IP地址

DatabaseType.description_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
DatabaseType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值：

MySQL
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain to which the database belongs
NetworkDomainId.description_zh: 数据库所属的网络域的ID

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the project to which the database belongs

Source.description_en:
The source of the database. Valid values:

Local: local database instance
Rds: ApsaraDB RDS instance
PolarDB: PolarDB instance
Source.description_zh:
数据库的来源。取值：

Local：本地数据库实例
Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例

SourceInstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the ApsaraDB RDS or PolarDB instance that corresponds to the database.
If Source is set to Local, this parameter is empty
SourceInstanceId.description_zh:
数据库对应的RDS实例ID或PolarDB实例ID。
Source为Local时，该参数返回值为空

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库总数量
